description.en: The ID of the Cloud Backup client.

description.zh: 备份客户端类型。取值为**ECS_AGENT**，表示SAP HANA备份客户端。
description.en: The type of the Cloud Backup client. Valid value: **ECS_AGENT**, which indicates an SAP HANA backup client.
The ID of the SAP HANA instance.

description.zh: 分页页码，从1开始，默认值为1。
description.en: The page number. Pages start from page 1. Default value: 1.

description.zh: 分页大小，最小值为1，最大值为99，默认值为10。
description.en: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 99. Default value: 10.
The ID of the resource group.

description.zh: 数据源类型，取值为**HANA**，表示SAP HANA备份。
description.en: The type of the data source. Valid value:**HANA**, which indicates SAP HANA backup.
The ID of the backup vault.

descriptions.zh: 该接口目前仅适用于SAP HANA备份，其他数据源的备份客户端请调用DescribeBackupClients接口。
descriptions.en: This operation is applicable only to SAP HANA backup. For Cloud Backup clients of other data sources, call the DescribeBackupClients operation.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun hbr describe-clients --vault-id v-0001vk0z000000xdyr --client-id c-000ed6000000006b0 --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --client-type ECS_AGENT --source-type HANA --cluster-id cl-0005ni10000002l87 --resource-group-id rg-acfmw6bxl7o5qyq --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun hbr DescribeClients --region cn-hangzhou --ClientType ECS_AGENT --PageSize 10 --ResourceGroupId 'rg-acfmw6bxl7o5qyq' --PageNumber 1 --ClusterId 'cl-0005ni10000002l87' --SourceType HANA --ClientId 'c-000ed6000000006b0' --VaultId 'v-0001vk0z000000xdyr'
